description: Source code for the AWCProxyContainer class and its nested DBusInterface class, managing container lifecycle via D-Bus communication, including start/stop operations and state change handling.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle including start, stop, and state monitoring, utilizing D-Bus interface.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface::onStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked on container state change, updates container's process ID and application state.

methods.description: Waits for the container to reach a specified application state within a timeout period.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with configuration and D-Bus client.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::~AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Destructor stopping container if running and cleaning up D-Bus bindings.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.description: Checks if the container is currently in the STARTED state.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waits for it to reach STARTED state.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Stop
